description: Scan a queue or subscription for messages matching a body substring, message id, or subject. Non-destructive. Scanning is bounded by maxMessages and by a server-side timeout, so on a deep backlog prefer a narrow filter. Returns matching messages with their sequence numbers. Prefer this over repeated peek_messages calls whenever you know something about the messages you want. The sequence numbers it returns are what delete_messages, resubmit_dead_letter and dead_letter_messages take as input. Needs the Data Receiver role (or Data Owner).

bodyFilter.description: Case-insensitive substring to find in the body.

namespace.description: Service Bus namespace name. Defaults to the server namespace.

queue.description: Queue name. Omit when using topic + subscription.

topic.description: Topic name, when searching a subscription.

name: search_messages
title: Search messages
